# src/scientific/astro_lorenz_b_spline_tokenizer.jl
# Astro-Lorenz B-Spline Tokenizer for JAIDE V35
# Integrates chaotic dynamics with spline interpolation for non-linear token embeddings.

using LinearAlgebra, SpecialFunctions, Distributions, FFTW, Random
using Test

export AstroLorenzTokenizer, tokenize, detokenize, embed_lorenz, b_spline_basis, lorenz_trajectory

struct CelestialConfig
    sigma::Float64  # Lorenz parameter
    rho::Float64
    beta::Float64
    dt::Float64     # Time step
    steps::Int      # Trajectory length
    grid_points::Int  # B-spline grid
    degree::Int     # Spline degree
    dim::Int        # Embedding dimension
end

function CelestialConfig(; sigma=10.0, rho=28.0, beta=8/3, dt=0.01, steps=100, grid_points=7, degree=3, dim=18432)
    CelestialConfig(sigma, rho, beta, dt, steps, grid_points, degree, dim)
end

mutable struct AstroLorenzTokenizer
    config::CelestialConfig
    knots::Vector{Float64}
    trajectory::Matrix{Float64}  # Precomputed Lorenz trajectory
    basis_cache::Dict{Tuple{Float64,Int},Vector{Float64}}  # B-spline basis cache
    vocab::Dict{Char,Int}
    inv_vocab::Dict{Int,Char}
    function AstroLorenzTokenizer(config::CelestialConfig)
        tk = new(config)
        tk.knots = collect(range(0.0, stop=1.0, length=config.grid_points + config.degree + 1))
        tk.trajectory = lorenz_trajectory(config)
        tk.basis_cache = Dict{Tuple{Float64,Int},Vector{Float64}}()
        tk.vocab = Dict(' ' => 0, 'a' => 1, 'b' => 2, 'c' => 3, 'd' => 4, 'e' => 5, 'f' => 6, 'g' => 7, 'h' => 8, 'i' => 9,
                        'j' => 10, 'k' => 11, 'l' => 12, 'm' => 13, 'n' => 14, 'o' => 15, 'p' => 16, 'q' => 17, 'r' => 18,
                        's' => 19, 't' => 20, 'u' => 21, 'v' => 22, 'w' => 23, 'x' => 24, 'y' => 25, 'z' => 26, 'J' => 27,
                        'A' => 28, 'I' => 29, 'D' => 30, 'E' => 31, 'V' => 32, '3' => 33, '5' => 34, 'F' => 35, 'M' => 36,
                        'R' => 37, 'N' => 38, '-' => 39, 'Ω' => 40, 'O' => 41, 'm' => 42, 'n' => 43, 'i' => 44, 'K' => 45,
                        'A' => 46, 'N' => 47, '–' => 48, 'U' => 49, 'l' => 50, 't' => 51, 'i' => 52, 'm' => 53, 'a' => 54,
                        't' => 55, 'e' => 56)
        tk.inv_vocab = Dict(v => k for (k, v) in tk.vocab)
        tk
    end
end

function lorenz_trajectory(config::CelestialConfig)::Matrix{Float64}
    x, y, z = config.sigma, config.rho, config.beta
    dt, steps = config.dt, config.steps
    traj = zeros(3, steps)
    x0, y0, z0 = 0.1, 1.0, 1.05
    for t = 1:steps
        dx = config.sigma * (y0 - x0)
        dy = x0 * (config.rho - z0) - y0
        dz = x0 * y0 - config.beta * z0
        x0 += dt * dx
        y0 += dt * dy
        z0 += dt * dz
        traj[1, t] = x0
        traj[2, t] = y0
        traj[3, t] = z0
    end
    traj
end

function b_spline_basis(x::Float64, knots::Vector{Float64}, degree::Int)::Vector{Float64}
    n_knots = length(knots)
    basis = zeros(Float64, n_knots - degree - 1)
    key = (x, degree)
    if haskey(tk.basis_cache, key)
        return tk.basis_cache[key]
    end
    if degree == 0
        for i = 1:(n_knots-1)
            if knots[i] <= x < knots[i+1]
                basis[i] = 1.0
            end
        end
    else
        for i = 1:(length(basis))
            left_num = (x - knots[i]) / (knots[i + degree] - knots[i])
            right_num = (knots[i + degree + 1] - x) / (knots[i + degree + 1] - knots[i + 1])
            left_denom = 1.0 / (knots[i + degree] - knots[i])
            right_denom = 1.0 / (knots[i + degree + 1] - knots[i + 1])
            left = left_num * b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)[i]
            right = right_num * b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)[i + 1]
            basis[i] = left + right
        end
    end
    tk.basis_cache[key] = basis
    basis
end

function embed_lorenz(token_ids::Vector{Int}, config::CelestialConfig, trajectory::Matrix{Float64})::Matrix{Float64}
    n_tokens = length(token_ids)
    emb_dim = config.dim
    embeds = zeros(Float64, n_tokens, emb_dim)
    for (t_idx, tid) in enumerate(token_ids)
        # Normalize token id to [0,1]
        norm_tid = Float64(tid) / Float64(length(tk.vocab))
        # Interpolate trajectory at norm_tid
        traj_point = trajectory[:, mod(t_idx - 1, config.steps) + 1]
        # B-spline modulation
        basis = b_spline_basis(norm_tid, tk.knots, config.degree)
        # Embed into full dim
        for d = 1:emb_dim
            phase = 2 * π * Float64(d) / Float64(emb_dim)
            mod_x = traj_point[1] * cos(phase) + traj_point[2] * sin(phase)
            spline_weight = sum(basis .* traj_point[3])
            embeds[t_idx, d] = norm_tid * mod_x * spline_weight
        end
    end
    embeds
end

function tokenize(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, text::String)::Vector{Int}
    token_ids = Int[]
    for char in text
        if haskey(tk.vocab, char)
            push!(token_ids, tk.vocab[char])
        else
            push!(token_ids, tk.vocab[' '])  # PAD or UNK
        end
    end
    return token_ids
end

function detokenize(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, ids::Vector{Int})::String
    chars = Char[]
    for id in ids
        if id in keys(tk.inv_vocab)
            push!(chars, tk.inv_vocab[id])
        else
            push!(chars, ' ')
        end
    end
    return join(chars)
end

function tokenize(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, text::String)::Vector{Int}
    token_ids = Int[]
    for char in text
        if haskey(tk.vocab, char)
            push!(token_ids, tk.vocab[char])
        else
            push!(token_ids, 3)  # UNK_ID
        end
    end
    push!(token_ids, 1)  # BOS
    return token_ids
end

function AstroLorenzTokenizer(; kwargs...)
    config = CelestialConfig(; kwargs...)
    AstroLorenzTokenizer(config)
end

# Full embedding pipeline
function full_embed(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, text::String)::Matrix{Float64}
    ids = tokenize(tk, text)
    embed_lorenz(ids, tk.config, tk.trajectory)
end

# Inverse embedding for decoding
function decode_embed(emb::Matrix{Float64}, tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer)::String
    # Simplified: argmax over dim to token
    n_tokens, dim = size(emb)
    ids = Int[]
    for t = 1:n_tokens
        max_val, max_d = findmax(emb[t, :])
        tid = mod(max_d - 1, length(tk.vocab)) + 1
        push!(ids, tid)
    end
    detokenize(tk, ids)
end

# FFT for spectral analysis in tokenizer
function spectral_tokenize(ids::Vector{Int}, config::CelestialConfig)::Matrix{ComplexF64}
    n = length(ids)
    fft_ids = fft(ids)
    spec_emb = zeros(ComplexF64, n, config.dim)
    for f = 1:config.dim
        freq = 2 * π * Float64(f) / Float64(config.dim)
        for t = 1:n
            spec_emb[t, f] = fft_ids[t] * exp(1im * freq * t)
        end
    end
    spec_emb
end

# Test suite
@testset "AstroLorenzTokenizer" begin
    config = CelestialConfig(steps=10, dim=10)
    tk = AstroLorenzTokenizer(config)
    @test length(tk.vocab) == 57
    text = "JAIDE"
    ids = tokenize(tk, text)
    @test length(ids) == 5  # + BOS
    @test ids[1] == 28  # J
    embeds = full_embed(tk, text)
    @test size(embeds) == (5, 10)
    decoded = decode_embed(embeds, tk)
    @test decoded ≈ "JAIDE"
    traj = lorenz_trajectory(config)
    @test size(traj) == (3, 10)
    basis = b_spline_basis(0.5, tk.knots, config.degree)
    @test length(basis) == 4
    spec = spectral_tokenize(ids, config)
    @test size(spec) == (5, 10)
end

# Precompute for efficiency
function precompute_basis(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, num_points::Int=100)
    for i = 1:num_points
        x = Float64(i) / Float64(num_points)
        b_spline_basis(x, tk.knots, tk.config.degree)
    end
end

# Batch tokenization
function batch_tokenize(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, texts::Vector{String})::Vector{Vector{Int}}
    map(text -> tokenize(tk, text), texts)
end

# Padded batch embedding
function padded_embed(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, batch_ids::Vector{Vector{Int}}, max_len::Int)::Matrix{Float64}
    n_batch = length(batch_ids)
    padded = map(ids -> vcat(ids, fill(0, max_len - length(ids))), batch_ids)
    embeds = zeros(Float64, n_batch, max_len, tk.config.dim)
    for b = 1:n_batch
        embeds[b, :, :] .= embed_lorenz(padded[b], tk.config, tk.trajectory)
    end
    return reshape(permutedims(embeds, [1, 3, 2]), n_batch, tk.config.dim, max_len)
end

# End of astro_lorenz_b_spline_tokenizer.jl

using FFTW, Test

struct CelestialConfig
    sigma::Float64
    rho::Float64
    beta::Float64
    dt::Float64
    steps::Int
    grid_points::Int
    degree::Int
    dim::Int
end

function CelestialConfig(; sigma=10.0, rho=28.0, beta=8/3, dt=0.01, steps=100, grid_points=7, degree=3, dim=18432)
    CelestialConfig(sigma, rho, beta, dt, steps, grid_points, degree, dim)
end

mutable struct AstroLorenzTokenizer
    config::CelestialConfig
    knots::Vector{Float64}
    trajectory::Matrix{Float64}
    basis_cache::Dict{Tuple{Float64,Int},Vector{Float64}}
    vocab::Dict{Char,Int}
    inv_vocab::Dict{Int,Char}
end

function default_vocab()
    base_chars = Char[]
    for c in 'A':'Z'
        push!(base_chars, c)
    end
    for c in 'a':'z'
        push!(base_chars, c)
    end
    for c in '0':'9'
        push!(base_chars, c)
    end
    for c in ['-','_','.','!','?','@','#','$','%','&','*','+','/','\\',':',';','(',')',',','\'','"']
        push!(base_chars, c)
    end
    vocab = Dict{Char,Int}()
    id = 1
    for c in base_chars
        vocab[c] = id
        id += 1
    end
    vocab[' '] = 0
    inv_vocab = Dict{Int,Char}()
    for (c,i) in vocab
        inv_vocab[i] = c
    end
    return vocab, inv_vocab
end

function lorenz_trajectory(config::CelestialConfig)::Matrix{Float64}
    dt, steps, sigma, rho, beta = config.dt, config.steps, config.sigma, config.rho, config.beta
    traj = zeros(Float64, 3, steps)
    x, y, z = 0.1, 1.0, 1.05
    for t in 1:steps
        dx = sigma * (y - x)
        dy = x * (rho - z) - y
        dz = x * y - beta * z
        x += dt * dx
        y += dt * dy
        z += dt * dz
        traj[1, t] = x
        traj[2, t] = y
        traj[3, t] = z
    end
    return traj
end

function AstroLorenzTokenizer(config::CelestialConfig)
    knots = collect(range(0.0, stop=1.0, length=config.grid_points + config.degree + 1))
    trajectory = lorenz_trajectory(config)
    basis_cache = Dict{Tuple{Float64,Int},Vector{Float64}}()
    vocab, inv_vocab = default_vocab()
    return AstroLorenzTokenizer(config, knots, trajectory, basis_cache, vocab, inv_vocab)
end

function AstroLorenzTokenizer(; kwargs...)
    config = CelestialConfig(; kwargs...)
    return AstroLorenzTokenizer(config)
end

function b_spline_basis(x::Float64, knots::Vector{Float64}, degree::Int)::Vector{Float64}
    n = length(knots) - degree - 1
    if degree == 0
        basis = zeros(Float64, n)
        for i in 1:n
            if (knots[i] <= x && x < knots[i + 1]) || (x == knots[end] && i == n)
                basis[i] = 1.0
            end
        end
        return basis
    else
        prev = b_spline_basis(x, knots, degree - 1)
        basis = zeros(Float64, n)
        for i in 1:n
            denom1 = knots[i + degree] - knots[i]
            denom2 = knots[i + degree + 1] - knots[i + 1]
            term1 = denom1 != 0.0 ? ((x - knots[i]) / denom1) * prev[i] : 0.0
            term2 = denom2 != 0.0 ? ((knots[i + degree + 1] - x) / denom2) * prev[i + 1] : 0.0
            basis[i] = term1 + term2
        end
        return basis
    end
end

function b_spline_basis_cached!(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, x::Float64)::Vector{Float64}
    key = (x, tk.config.degree)
    if haskey(tk.basis_cache, key)
        return tk.basis_cache[key]
    end
    b = b_spline_basis(x, tk.knots, tk.config.degree)
    tk.basis_cache[key] = b
    return b
end

function embed_lorenz(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, token_ids::Vector{Int})::Matrix{Float64}
    n_tokens = length(token_ids)
    emb_dim = tk.config.dim
    embeds = zeros(Float64, n_tokens, emb_dim)
    max_id = maximum(collect(keys(tk.inv_vocab)))
    for (t_idx, tid) in enumerate(token_ids)
        denom = max(max_id, 1)
        norm_tid = clamp(Float64(tid) / Float64(denom), 0.0, 1.0)
        traj_point = tk.trajectory[:, ((t_idx - 1) % tk.config.steps) + 1]
        basis = b_spline_basis_cached!(tk, norm_tid)
        s = sum(basis) * traj_point[1]
        for d in 1:emb_dim
            phase = 2 * pi * Float64(d) / Float64(emb_dim)
            mod_x = traj_point * cos(phase) + traj_point * sin(phase)[2][3]
            embeds[t_idx, d] = norm_tid * mod_x * s
        end
    end
    return embeds
end

function tokenize(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, text::String)::Vector{Int}
    token_ids = Int[]
    for char in text
        if haskey(tk.vocab, char)
            push!(token_ids, tk.vocab[char])
        else
            push!(token_ids, 0)
        end
    end
    return token_ids
end

function detokenize(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, ids::Vector{Int})::String
    chars = Char[]
    for id in ids
        if haskey(tk.inv_vocab, id)
            push!(chars, tk.inv_vocab[id])
        else
            push!(chars, ' ')
        end
    end
    return String(chars)
end

function full_embed(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, text::String)::Matrix{Float64}
    ids = tokenize(tk, text)
    return embed_lorenz(tk, ids)
end

function decode_embed(emb::Matrix{Float64}, tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer)::String
    n_tokens, dim = size(emb)
    ids = Int[]
    max_id = maximum(collect(keys(tk.inv_vocab)))
    for t in 1:n_tokens
        _, max_d = findmax(view(emb, t, :))
        tid = mod(max_d - 1, max_id) + 1
        push!(ids, tid)
    end
    return detokenize(tk, ids)
end

function spectral_tokenize(ids::Vector{Int}, config::CelestialConfig)::Matrix{ComplexF64}
    n = length(ids)
    fft_ids = fft(ComplexF64.(ids))
    spec_emb = zeros(ComplexF64, n, config.dim)
    for f in 1:config.dim
        freq = 2 * pi * Float64(f) / Float64(config.dim)
        for t in 1:n
            spec_emb[t, f] = fft_ids[t] * exp(im * freq * t)
        end
    end
    return spec_emb
end

@testset "AstroLorenzTokenizer" begin
    config = CelestialConfig(steps=10, dim=10)
    tk = AstroLorenzTokenizer(config)
    @test haskey(tk.vocab, 'J')
    text = "JAIDE"
    ids = tokenize(tk, text)
    @test length(ids) == 5
    @test ids == tk.vocab['J'][2]
    embeds = full_embed(tk, text)
    @test size(embeds) == (5, 10)
    @test detokenize(tk, ids) == text
    traj = lorenz_trajectory(config)
    @test size(traj) == (3, 10)
    basis = b_spline_basis(0.5, tk.knots, config.degree)
    @test length(basis) == length(tk.knots) - config.degree - 1
    spec = spectral_tokenize(ids, config)
    @test size(spec) == (5, 10)
end

function precompute_basis(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, num_points::Int=100)
    for i in 0:num_points
        x = Float64(i) / Float64(num_points)
        b_spline_basis_cached!(tk, x)
    end
end

function batch_tokenize(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, texts::Vector{String})::Vector{Vector{Int}}
    return [tokenize(tk, text) for text in texts]
end

function padded_embed(tk::AstroLorenzTokenizer, batch_ids::Vector{Vector{Int}}, max_len::Int)::Array{Float64,3}
    n_batch = length(batch_ids)
    padded = [vcat(ids, fill(0, max(0, max_len - length(ids))))[1:max_len] for ids in batch_ids]
    embeds = zeros(Float64, n_batch, max_len, tk.config.dim)
    for b in 1:n_batch
        embeds[b, :, :] .= embed_lorenz(tk, padded[b])
    end
    return permutedims(embeds, (1, 3, 2))
end
